lines.text: Many learners say: Although it was cold, but I went out.
Better: Although it was cold, I went out.
Use although or but, not both.
No but! Although it rained, we played outside.

data.wrong: Although it was cold, but I went out.
data.right: Although it was cold, I went out.
data.why: Use although or but, not both.

en.hook: Do not use although with but!
en.tip: Use although or but, not both. Say “Although it was cold, I went out.”
